scenes.scope: Visual frame sampling and existing quantitative QA; no real-time motion playback or ambience audition
findings: Hearth flames change shape over seven half-second samples; smoke/light stays within the fireplace opening.

Warm smoke haze grows on the hearth right side mid-loop but does not visibly enter the room; acceptable at normal scene size.
Mug steam is extremely subtle; temporal realism of that effect was not established from samples.
Seam change 0.2247 versus typical 0.1817 (1.2366x) supports a low seam risk; full-speed loop playback remains desirable.
